prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify a related action menu for the selected iPad report. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. A chooser shows the last executed command as if it were persistent state, mixes Share, Duplicate and Delete with theme settings and always executes the first item when opened. Sometimes no report is selected.

criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
